title: Honey glazed chicken

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Honey glazed chicken is a Mistlands-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Uncooked honey glazed chicken is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 1 Chicken meat
• 3 Honey
• 2 Jotun puffs
Honey glazed chicken is produced by cooking uncooked honey glazed chicken in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• While Honey glazed chicken provides less health and stamina than Misthare supreme, it lasts for five minutes longer.
• Honey glazed chicken provides the same health and stamina as Meat platter, making the two of them tied for the second highest health gain in the Mistlands.
